## Research, hypothesis and limits

All60 top-three team views in the frozen30-game leader-v-leader sample contain
Cassi/Issac. Their combined banking is2169/18318 for Fish,1719/15573 for Mite,
2393/14324 for Pantheon; linked deaths make actor death counts correlated. A
rank750 sample also uses them and loses heavily, so copying a pick alone is
not a winning-policy claim. Verified Fish Vault first-center contributions include
Cassi870 and Issac995 of5880HP removed by33; both actually work, not just final
kill credit. Against Pantheon on Swirl, Fish Issac contests an imminent capture
but dies with linked Cassi; another actor still secures Fish's separate reward.

Hypothesis: one extra independently controlled body increases productive capture
and banking enough to offset foregone Ren, linked deaths/bags, congestion and
six-body planning cost. Keep the first three core picks and three-choice maps.
This tests our retained executor, not a reconstruction of leader source.

Current SDK: one draft pair expands to two physical actors, separate turns/bags/
shop/state; either death kills both and loses both bags. Physical enums differ
from draft enums. Six bodies fit runtime vectors and protocol slots0–5; max
route packet251bytes<1024. Existing shop uses Focus for Cassi, Strength for Issac.
Generic combat handles damage/CC/reset and navigation handles dash, but current
enemy-range filtering and movement exclusivity may underuse Cassi's range4 kit.
Do not fix those separately scoped behaviors in this roster trial.

## Exact policy and necessary integration

For map draft-choice count>=4 only, swap Ren and Cassi/Issac in the shared
preference list. First five choices become Heart, Marcella, Vesper, pair,
Vendetta; Ren becomes the last fallback, so every choice remains unique.
For three-choice maps, preserve original preferences and five-body route template.

On active maps the five-choice route template expands to Heart/Marcella/Vesper/
Cassi/Issac/Vendetta. A four-choice game has5 actual actors and still prepares
the unused final choice, preserving the existing template convention; a
five-choice game has6 actors. Do not trim planning to the map-sized prefix.
Select a small pure roster plan from the legal map choice count and ensure both
draft and route preparation consume that SAME plan. Extend the existing shared
roster module; do not introduce another hardcoded physical-type policy list.
Avoid redundant live SDK queries or runtime expansion/allocation where possible.

Use existing planner algorithm, route ordering, budget-share formula and packet
format. The sixth body changes the denominator naturally; record this unavoidable
interaction rather than claiming to isolate pure body count. Add Cassi to the
existing route caster estimate (Heart/Ren), matching her existing Focus shopping;
preserve every original actor's estimate, including Marcella. No new shop logic.
Keep type-keyed packet ownership and empty/partial fallback; don't use slots or
enum casts as a substitute for physical type. No remote partner observations.

Everything else remains unchanged: combat, capture occupation, navigation,
coordination flag, priorities/formula, healing/escape, banking, equipment,
task expiry, objective admission, planner knobs and telemetry. No pair escort,
partner-health policy, new shared fields, map-name rules or debug output.
